LLC Podcast Episode 64: The One with Corners

Control Resonant, and a huge Nintendo Direct catchup.
Adam Cook September 21, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:47
Instaread

After a week off, Mick, Lyle, Kieran, and Steve are back with basically two podcast episodes in one.

Control Resonant is out next week, but Mick has been playing it feverishly for his review (which is live now), and you can hear a great deal about that game on this episode, with no spoilers of course.

Elsewhere, Nintendo held not one but two Nintendo Direct showcases, showing a huge amount of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time off. Not the old game, the remake, of course. We know a date, and how it looks, and a lot more. So the quartet chat about that, and break down the entire Nintendo Direct that followed it the day after. It’s been a mad few weeks, hasn’t it?

Lyle has played and absolutely fallen for Moonlighter 2, but he’s also been playing Orbitals, a co-op adventure that is in the genre being dubbed “Hazelike”. No, us neither. Even with all of that, there’s time for a quick look at Onimusha (though more on that next episode), and Mick has reviewed Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2.

Not enough? The four also have plenty to say about the Grand Theft Auto VI reveal on Netflix.

Phew, we did say it was a bumper episode.
